title: Art with math :) I spend a great part of time fixing this "Open holes" Help
author: NeighborhoodFew677
selftext:
Art with math :) I spend a great part of time fixing this "Open holes" on the character back any idea why claude makes this error so many times? Or it is just me?

Soon will add this guy to the game [https://tentaculogames.pt/keeprolling/](https://tentaculogames.pt/keeprolling/)

I am not using external assets just "stuff made inside claude".

comments.author: Arya_the_Gamer
comments.body:
Likely probably cause claude builds character by joining multiple separate shapes, and not from building and extruding from one shape.

For something like this it's better to have a human manually fix it or have ai make reference images and you just do a quick modelling yourself.
